import novamind_api as nm
print("=== ACTIONS wk16 day112 ===")

# 1. Prices: A 18->20 (S1 harvest experiment), B 80->88 (ratchet, churn 0.51% safe), C 159->174 (sticky)
r = nm.pricing.set_prices(A=20, B=88, C=174)
print("PRICES:", r.get('current', r))

# 2. Ads: scale content 1500->2200 (139/$1k no saturation), hold others. All S2. Total 3500/day.
r = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S2": 2200},
    "linkedin": {"S2": 500},
    "social_media": {"S2": 450},
    "referral_program": {"S2": 350},
})
print("ADS:", r)

# 3. Dev: S2 targeted 1000->1500 (quality = conv+retention+pricing-power engine)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 1500})
print("DEV S2:", r)

# 4. Lead promo: keep global 5, S1 5, bump S2 31->39 (hold B eval ~44 as B->88)
r = nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5, by_group={"S1": 5, "S2": 39})
print("LEADPROMO:", r)

# 5. S1-A churn by price (elasticity signal for future A decisions)
q = nm.query("SELECT s.effective_price ep, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.group_id='S1' AND s.plan='A' AND s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>105 GROUP BY s.effective_price ORDER BY s.effective_price")
print("\nS1-A CANCELS by price 7d:", q['rows'])

# 6. Social crisis check (rising issues -> reputation risk?)
sp = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=12)
print("\n=== SOCIAL (last 7d) ===")
for p in sp['posts']:
    print(f"  [{p.get('group_id','?')}] {p.get('content','')[:85]}")

# 7. Macro
mo = nm.market.get_market_overview()
mac = mo.get('macroeconomic', {})
print("\nMACRO: PMI", mac.get('pmi_value'), "cycle", mac.get('cycle_phase'))
